title: Review package unit context (package-unit-context/1)
description: The unit-wide material of one hunted review unit, published once by assemble-review-packages/14 (review/packages.py, _Assembler.unit_context_document) under unit-context/<sha256>.json beside the packages and referenced by every hunt partition of the unit through its body's unit_context {schema, path, sha256, size_bytes, counts}. The document is canonical JSON; its identity is the SHA-256 of its bytes. It carries no run or manifest identity: the same accepted facts give the same document in any run, and the hunt body that references it pins run_id and manifest_sha256. assemble_packages validates it before publication and load_unit_context validates it again before any consumer merges it back into a package body (merge_unit_context).

scope.description: The unit's scope without a partition key: every partition of the unit shares it.

context.description: The unit's bounded context entries, in the order the package body carried them before schema v7.

entity_ids.description: The unit-wide retrieval grant: the unit's source files, its context entries and the resolved underlying evidence of context-level control assessments. A package's retrieval.entity_ids is the sorted union of its own identities and these.
